notes.title: Major Update for Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator: Prologue
notes.content:
🚨 Major Update for Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator: Prologue! 🍣

We’re thrilled to announce a delicious new update for Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator: Prologue, packed with exciting features to enhance your sushi restaurant experience! Dive into the latest improvements and additions that will make your culinary journey even more immersive and engaging.

What’s New in This Update?

✨ Enhanced Graphics
Feast your eyes on upgraded visuals! We’ve revamped the game’s graphics to bring a more vibrant and polished look to your sushi restaurant, making every dish and detail pop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525322/de5bf6ae946b74cf528fd715ade9f0531cac07ea.png

🍤 New Sushi Unlocks
Expand your menu with fresh sushi recipes! Discover and serve new sushi varieties to delight your customers and boost your restaurant’s reputation.

👨‍🍳 Hire Chefs at Shop Level 10
Reach Shop Level 10 to unlock the ability to hire talented chefs! They’ll help streamline your operations, allowing you to focus on growing your sushi empire.

🍱 Handle Customer Requests from Workbench
Multitasking just got easier! When customers are in range, you can now fulfill their sushi requests directly from the workbench, keeping the service flowing smoothly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525322/36af12ecf297e6c47271301275ffd3dcddd15070.png

📊 Improved Conveyor Belt Indication
Stay in control with new conveyor belt visibility! You can now see exactly how many sushi items are on the belt, helping you manage your restaurant more efficiently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525322/189211c69cb91b821b734a7dee578d8a8677d3cb.png

Thank you for your continued support, chefs! We’re committed to making Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator the ultimate sushi restaurant experience. Share your feedback on Steam or our Discord, and let us know what you’d like to see next!
